products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and art application distributed freely to users. The foundation operates under community governance, meaning development priorities and project direction are guided by its contributor and user community rather than commercial shareholders or investors.

The foundation's AI-related offering is tracked as Krita AI, which the site presents as an open-source digital art environment that supports local AI plugins without reliance on cloud infrastructure. This approach allows users to run AI-assisted features on their own hardware, avoiding data transmission to third-party services.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are associated with the Krita Foundation in the available data.
